title: Popup Studio: choose the workbench world
question: The roll assigned the Seed Vault Index. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. The popups keep their brand looks whatever you pick; this choice sets the workbench around them.

options.label: Seed Vault Index
options.lineage: Seed-bank accession cabinets: steel drawers, label holders, accession cards, viability stamps
options.thesis: Every popup is an accession: filed by brand drawer, catalogued by source, stamped when it passes QA.
options.viewport: Left: four brand drawers with label holders, each opening into its accession cards (source, trigger, code). Centre: the pulled popup at desktop and mobile on a cool steel tray. Right: the accession card, with locked copy fields, image slots, QA stamps and Export.
options.risk: Reads cold and clinical if the stamps and label holders are drawn timidly; the steel must stay quiet so the brand colours carry.

raised.raise: Colour is law: a brand's colour appears only on its own drawer label and its popups, never as workbench chrome.
One axis rules every line: a single accession spine aligns brand → source → variant → QA → export down the left edge.
Chrome deleted: no boxed panels; structure comes from label holders, ruled type and the tray edge only.
State is depth: the pulled accession lifts forward; everything filed recedes a step in tone.

regions.label: accession card: copy, image, QA, export

options.label: Form Builder Grammar
options.lineage: The Klaviyo and Figma editor layout the team already uses daily
options.thesis: A step rail, a canvas and a properties panel, so it feels like the tools they already use.
options.viewport: Top bar with brand tabs; left step rail (Source, Variant, Copy, Image, QA, Export); centre canvas with a device toggle; right properties panel.
options.risk: The most familiar option, and where most runs in this category land; low learning cost, but no identity of its own.

options.label: Proofing Darkroom
options.thesis: Popups move through fixed stations (compose, test strip, fix, dispatch), and the variants sit side by side like test strips before you commit.
options.viewport: A dark bench with one popup under the enlarger beam, and three variant test strips below it.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for clarity: the station order is the real workflow and test strips are the variants. Marketers won't recognise themselves in a darkroom.
options.risk: The dark amber room fights the brand colours and reads as a novelty.

options.label: One-Up Review Feed
options.thesis: One popup owns the stage; snap to the next source; a right rail of actions (edit, QA, export).
options.viewport: A popup filling the stage, the source and trigger as a low caption, and four glyph actions stacked on the right.
options.case: Holds clarity for reviewing 30 popups one at a time; loses on editing density and on identifying with the team's desk work.
options.risk: Editing copy inside a feed gets cramped; it feels like a phone app on a desktop task.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.thesis: Cloud colour decides where each drop falls.
options.viewport: A garden where brands are clouds.
options.case: Loses on both axes: whimsical physics hides a production task.
options.kept: Colour as law: each colour means exactly one thing.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.thesis: Descend through stages on one depth axis.
options.case: Loses on both axes: no marketer identifies with a dive log.
options.kept: One vertical axis ruling every line.
options.risk: Dark and atmospheric where the task needs light and fast.

options.label: Metro Type Tiles
options.thesis: Giant cropped lowercase; tiles as the only doors.
options.case: Loses on both axes: colour tiles compete with the brand colours.
options.kept: Chrome deleted: type and edges do the structuring.
options.risk: Colour fields clash with four brand palettes.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.thesis: Rank is depth over a black void.
options.case: Loses on both axes: it looks like a dev tool, which the team ruled out.
options.kept: State is depth: selection lifts forward, the rest recedes.
options.risk: Exactly the dev-tool feel the brief rules out.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS template gallery: sidebar filters, a grid of popup thumbnails, and a detail drawer.
canonCard.viewport: Filter sidebar, a thumbnail grid of all popups, and clicking one opens an editor drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any template marketplace by design.
